learningGoals: Understand what position words are and how they help us explain where things are! 🧠
Correctly identify and use 'in', 'on', and 'under' in everyday sentences. 🗣️
Describe the location of objects easily using words like 'behind' and 'near'. 🧸
Improve listening and action skills by following simple directions involving position words. 👂
teachingTips: Play a fun placement game with toys! Ask your child to put their favorite teddy 'on' the chair, 'under' the table, or 'in' the toy box. 🧸
Use hide-and-seek to practice words like 'behind' and 'near'. When you find them, say out loud, 'I found you behind the curtain!' 🙈
Turn mealtime into a quick learning moment. Ask them if their spoon is 'in' the bowl or 'near' the plate. 🥣
Read picture books together and pause to ask, 'Where is the dog?' Encourage them to answer using the correct position words. 📖

funActivities.title: The Magic Cup Game 🪄
funActivities.description: Take a small toy and a plastic cup. Ask your child to close their eyes while you place the toy 'in', 'on', or 'under' the cup. Have them open their eyes and say the correct position word!

funActivities.title: Room Detective 🕵️‍♂️
funActivities.description: Give your child a pretend magnifying glass and ask them to find objects around the room based on your clues. For example, 'Find something under the bed' or 'Find something near the door'.

funActivities.title: Living Room Obstacle Course 🚧
funActivities.description: Create a safe indoor obstacle course using pillows and chairs. Guide your child to crawl 'under' the table, sit 'on' the cushion, and stand 'behind' the sofa. They will love learning through movement!
